pages.title: Product Galleries
pages.content:
Kadence Shop Kit allows you to customize how product galleries appear on your WooCommerce products. You can replace the default product gallery with a slider layout and include videos alongside your product images for a richer shopping experience.

Getting Started

If you don’t already have Shop Kit installed on your site, you can[follow these steps](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/install-activate-kadence-shop-kit/) to get started.

- From your WordPress dashboard, click **Shop Kit**.
- Open the **Product Gallery** tab.

Enable the **Product Slider Gallery** option.

![Kadence Shop Kit - Enable Product Slider Gallery](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Screenshot-2025-08-07-at-3.49.02-PM.png)

Choosing a Gallery Type

Kadence Shop Kit allows you to control how your product galleries are displayed, including the layout of images and the placement of product thumbnails.

![Gallery - Thumbnails Below Image](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/thumb-below-img-847x1024-1.png)Thumbnails Below Image

![Gallery - Thumbnails To The Left of Image](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/thumb-beside-img-right-1024x955-1.png)Thumbnails To The Left of Image

![Gallery - Thumbnails To The Right of Image](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/thumb-beside-slider-left-1024x957-1.png)Thumbnails To The Right of Image

![Gallery - No Thumbnails, Images in a List](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/no-thumb-list-713x1024-1.png)No Thumbnails, Images in a List

![Gallery - Images in a Two-Column Grid](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/2column-grid-689x1024-1.png)Images in a Two-Column Grid

![Gallery - Images in a Tile Layout](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/tile-681x1024-1.png)Images in a Tile Layout

![Gallery - Images in a Slider Layout, no Thumbnails](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/slider-no-thumb-888x1024-1.png)Images in a Slider Layout, no Thumbnails

Gallery Settings

Next, you can choose to enable or disable custom size for gallery images. Enabling this feature will allow you to set a custom product image width and ratio for your product gallery images.

![Shop Kit Gallery Settings](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/customizesizes.gif)

**Slider Transition** – Choose between *Slide* or *Fade*

**Slider Transition Speed** – Adjust the speed between slides

**Slider Auto Play** – Enable or disable automatic sliding

**Slider Pause Time** – Set how long each slide is displayed

![Shop Kit Gallery Slider Settings](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Screenshot-2025-08-07-at-4.11.55-PM.png)

![Shop Kit Gallery Settings](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Screenshot-2025-08-07-at-4.47.41-PM.png)

**Enable Product Image Hover Zoom** – Allows image magnification to appear either on top of the image or beside it

**Show slide arrows on product image** – Enable navigation arrows on the product image slider

**Thumbnail Hover Selection** – Enable or disable thumbnail hover behavior (applies only to galleries with thumbnails)

**Enable Lightbox** – Required to display videos in the product gallery

**Lightbox Style** – Choose between *Light* or *Dark*

**Show Image Captions** – Display image captions as overlays

**Enable Meta Area for Shortcode Override** – Adds a metabox to each product, allowing you to replace the gallery with a shortcode or custom HTML

Adding Videos to Your Gallery

Kadence Shop Kit allows you to include YouTube or Vimeo videos directly in your product gallery. To use this feature, the [Lightbox theme setting](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/theme/lightbox-feature-for-image-links/) must be enabled. No additional settings are required.

- Edit a product.
- Click Add Product Gallery Images.
- Select an image to use as a placeholder for the video (required).
- Scroll down to the Product Video URL (YouTube, Vimeo) field.
- Paste your video URL.
- Click Add to Gallery.

![Shop Gallery - select image and add video](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Zight-Recording-2025-08-07-at-04.27.14-PM.gif)

View Your Product Videos

To view a product video on the front end of your site, navigate to the product page. Click the video thumbnail, then click the main image. The lightbox will open and automatically play the video.

![Shop Kit video lightbox demo](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Zight-Recording-2025-08-07-at-04.40.38-PM.gif)

## Variation Gallery Support

The Shop Kit Product Gallery feature is required to support **Variation** **Galleries**. When enabled, Variation Galleries allow you to assign multiple images to each product variation. As customers select different variations, the product gallery dynamically updates to show only the images associated with the selected variation.

**Dependency Notice**

Variation Galleries depend on the Product Gallery feature. If the Product Gallery is disabled:

- Variation Galleries will not display on the front end
- Variation images will not replace the main product gallery
- The gallery will remain static, even when variations are selected

To use Variation Galleries, ensure the Product Gallery feature is enabled in **Shop Kit → Product Gallery**.

pages.title: Product Quickview
pages.content:
With the **Kadence Shop Kit** plugin, you can improve the shopping experience by adding a **Quickview Button** to your **Product Shop and Archive Items**. This feature allows users to view detailed product information and add items to their cart without leaving the current page.

The **Quickview** functionality includes many features, including some of the ones listed below.

- Quickly access product details in a responsive popup modal.
- Navigate between products using left/right arrows to view previous or next products in the loop.
- Select product variation**s** (where applicable).
- Add products directly to their cart, eliminating the need to visit the *Single Product Page*.
- Use WooTemplates to fully customize the Quickview Modal.

This feature is particularly useful for **improving** the **user** **experience**, **encouraging** **faster** **checkouts**, and making it **easier** for customers to**complete their purchases**with fewer steps.

![Product Quickview Demo](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Product-Quickview-Demo.gif)

Getting Started

To get started with**Quickview**, first, ensure that the [Kadence Shop Ki](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/install-activate-kadence-shop-kit/)**t plugin**is activated on your website. Once activated, navigate to the **Dashboard** and go to the **Shop Kit** page. From there, click on the **Product** **Quickview** tab. Within this section, you’ll find the option to *Enable Product Quickview*. Simply toggle the setting to activate this feature, allowing you to display a **Quickview** **Button** on your WooCommerce products.

![Enabling Product quickview](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Enabling-Product-quickview.gif)

Quickview Settings

**Automatically Insert Button:**When this option is enabled, the Product Quickview Button can be placed using one of the pre-built placement options. *(See the next setting)*. If this option is disabled, you can use a ShortCode to display the Product Quickview Button dynamically. [Click here](#using-a-quickview-shortcode) to learn more about using a Quickview Shortcode.

**Button Placement:** When the Automatically Insert Button setting is enabled, use the Button Placement to determine where the Product Quickview Button will be placed. Below are the available placement options:

- Before Add to Cart
- After Add to Cart
- Before Price
- After Price
- Before Title
- After Title
- Before Item
- After item

**Quickview Button Show Text:** Enable this option to use a Button Text for the Quickview Button. Use the Quickview button Text setting to Set the Text for the Quickview Button. The default text is Quickview.

**Add a Button Icon:**Use this option to enable and use a Button Icon for the Quickview Button. The following Icons can be used for this feature:

- Play
- Eye
- Click

**Button Icon Color:** Set the Icon Color for the Quickview Button in the normal state.

**Button Icon Color Hover:** Set an Icon Hover Color for the Quickview Button when hovering over it.

![Quickview1](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Quickview1.jpg)

**Button Text Color:** Set a Button Text Color for the Quickview Button in the normal state.

**Button Text Color Hover:** Set a Button Text Color for the Quickview Button when being hovered over.

**Button Background:** Set a Button Background Color for the Quickview Button in the normal state.

**Button Background Hover:** Set a Button Background Hover Color for the Quickview Button when hovering over it.

**Button Border Width:**Use the Slider or enter a Value to set a Button Border Width for the Quickview Button. The unit of measurement is in pixels and will apply to all sides of the button.

![Quickview2](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Quickview2.jpg)

**Button Border Color:** Set a Button Border Color for the Quickview Button in the normal state.
**Button Border Color Hover**: Set a Button Border Hover Color for the Quickview Button when hovering over it.

**Button Border Radius:**Use the Slider or enter a Value to set a Button Border Radius. This is measured in Pixels and will apply to all sides of the button.

**Allow Scrolling:** Enabling this option allows users to swipe or use arrow navigation buttons to view the previous or next product in the loop.

**Use a Woo Template:** Enable this option to Use a Woo Template for the Quickview Popup Modal instead of the default Quickview layout. You can learn more about this feature in the section below.

![Quickview3](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Quickview3.jpg)

Creating a Custom Quickview WooTemplate

WooTemplates can be used to create a Custom Quickview Template. To do so, you should first enable Product Templates from the Dashboard -> ShopKit page. Look for the Product Templates option, then use the toggle to enable the feature.

![Product Template](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Product-Template.jpg)

Once **Product** **Templates** are enabled, refresh the page, then navigate to the **Dashboard -> Products -> WooTemplates**Page. Here, you can click on the **Add** **New** **Woo** **Template** button to add a new WooTemplate to the website. Then, select the **Quickview** **Template** option.

![Product Quickview Woo Template](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Product-Quickview-Woo-Template.gif)

The default layout template uses the [Product Gallery Block](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/product-gallery-block/). This block will also have the WooCommerce Sales Tag enabled. If you are using **Kadence Product Badges**, you should disable this setting.

![salet ag](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/saletag-1024x522-1.png)

You can use the default layout template to customize it to meet your needs or start from a blank template. Use a combination of Kadence Blocks and WooTemplate Blocks to display dynamic content. Here are some useful blocks to help you get started.

- [Product: Gallery Block](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/product-gallery-block/)
- [Product: Title Block](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/product-title-block/)
- [Product: Price Block](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/product-price-block/)
- [Product: Add to Cart Block](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/product-add-to-cart-block/)
- **Click here**to see all of the available **WooTemplate** **Blocks**.

![Adding Wootemplate Blocks](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Adding-Wootemplate-Blocks.gif)

You can also use the standard **Gutenberg** and **Kadence** **Blocks**, along with the **Kadence** **Dynamic** **Content**and****other**Block Features**. Allowing you to completely customize the **Quickview** **Popup** **Modal**.

![Dynamic Content in Quickview Templates](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Dynamic-Content-in-Quickview-Templates.gif)

The Quickview Template uses a [Product Short Description Block](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/product-short-description-block/). This shows a shorter version of the full description. You can use the [Dynamic HTML Block](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/dynamic-html-block/)to show the Post Content if you would rather display the entire description

![Full Description](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Full-Description.gif)

Once the WooTemplate is created, click on the Publish Button to save the template.

![Publish Wootemplate](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Publish-Wootemplate-scaled-1.jpg)

Once the WooTemplate is **Published**, navigate back to the **Dashboard -> ShopKit -> Product Overview** page. At the bottom of the settings, enable the option named **Use a WooTemplate**. You will then be able to select your newly created **WooTemplate** as the **Product** **Overview** **Popup** **Modal**.

![Selecting an Overview Template](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Selecting-an-Overview-Template.gif)

Don’t forget to click the **Save** **Settings** button to ensure the settings are saved. Afterward, the **WooTemplate** will be used as the **Overview** **Popup** **Modal**.

Using a Quickview ShortCode

In some cases, the *Quickview default Placement Options*may not meet your design goals. In this case, you can use the **Quickview ShortCode** to dynamically display the **Quickview Button** for the current product. This can be used in **Product Loop WooTemplates,** **Query (Adv) Blocks**, and anywhere else the current product information can be used within **Blocks**. 

To display the **Quickview** **Button** of the **Current** **Product**, use the following *ShortCode* inside of a *Gutenberg ShortCode Block:*

```
[kt_quickview_button]
```

To display a **Specfic** **Product** by **ID**, use the following *ShortCode* inside of a **Gutenberg ShortCode Block**:

```
[kt_quickview_button id="16"]
```

In place of 
```
16
```

, you should use the specific **Product** **ID** you wish to **Quickview**.

![ShortCode Template](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/ShortCode-Template-scaled-1.jpg)

![Quickview Sample Output](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Quickview-Sample-Output.jpg)

pages.title: Product Templates (Woo Templates)
pages.content:
Kadence **Shop Kit** features the **Product** **Templates** **(Woo Templates)** feature. Using Woo Templates, you can control WooCommerce Product Loop Items, Single Product Pages, and Product Archive pages. Kadence Product Templates feature various Woo Template blocks, such as the Product: Gallery and the Product: Add to Cart blocks, allowing you to customize various **WooCommerce** pages dynamically.

Enabling Woo Templates

In order to create a **Woo** **Template**, you must install, activate, and license the **Kadence** **Shop** **Kit** plugin. ([Click here to learn more](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/install-activate-kadence-shop-kit/).) Once the *Shop Kit plugin* is activated on the website, navigate to the **Dashboard -> Shop Kit** page and go to the **Product** **Templates** tab.

![Enable Product Templates](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Enable-Product-Templates.jpg)

*Enable Product Templates* and save the changes. Afterward, refresh the page. Then, navigate to the **Dashboard -> Products -> Woo Templates** page. At the top of the *Woo Templates page*, click on the **Add New Woo Templates** button to begin adding a new *Woo Template*.

![Add New Woo Template](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Add-New-Woo-Template-1024x850-1.jpg)

This will open a new **Woo** **Template** **Post** with the option to select the template type. There are a total of four *Woo Template Types*. Learn more about each template type below.

![Template Types](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Template-Types.jpg)

Types of Woo Templates

The available Woo Template types are: **Product** **Catalog** **Loop** **Item** templates, **Single** **Product** templates, **Product** **Archive** templates, and **Quickview** templates. Use core blocks, Kadence blocks, and **Woo Template blocks** to design and style your *Woo Templates*. Learn about each template type below.

[Click here](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/) for a list of all of the available Woo Template blocks.

Single Product Templates

**Single** **Product Woo** **Templates** give you full control over how your individual product pages appear.

You can use popular *Woo Template blocks*, such as the [Product Gallery](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/product-gallery-block/), [Product Price](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/product-price-block/), and [Product Add to Cart](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/product-add-to-cart-block/) blocks, to build the perfect product page layout.

Single Product Woo Templates offer three predesigned layouts to help you get started.

![Prebuilt Single Product Templates](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Prebuilt-Single-Product-Templates-scaled-1.jpg)

[Click here](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/build-single-product-template/) to view a complete overview of *Single Product Woo Templates* and how they work.

![Single Product Demo](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Single-Product-Demo.gif)

![Single Product Demo 1](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Single-Product-Demo-1-scaled-1.jpg)

Product Archive Templates

**Product Archive Woo Templates** let you customize the layout of your *WooCommerce Archive pages*, including your main Shop page and product category or tag pages. 

Choose between the **Advanced Query Loop**block or the **Archive Main Query Woo Template**block to display and style your products as preferred.

**Click here** to view a complete overview of *Product Archive Woo Templates* and how they work.

![Product Archive Demo](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Product-Archive-Demo.jpg)

![Archive Main Query](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Archive-Main-Query.gif)

Catalog Loop Item Templates

**Catalog Loop Item Woo Templates** can be used to take control over product loops across your website. *Catalog Loop Item templates* can be used anywhere the default product loop is, allowing you to control loop items universally as preferred.

*Catalog Loop Items*can also be used as a [Query Loop Card](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/blocks/advanced-query-loop-block/#query-loop-card) on an Advanced Query, allowing you to reuse the design in custom queries.

**Click here** to view a complete overview of *Product Catalog Item Woo Templates* and how they work.

![Loop Items](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Loop-Items-1024x485-1.jpg)

![Product Catalog Loop Item Demo](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Product-Catalog-Loop-Item-Demo-scaled-e1747168086321.jpg)

Quickview Templates

Kadence Shop Kit features the [Product Quickview](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/product-quickview/)feature. This feature allows users to view detailed product information and add items to their cart without leaving the current page.

![Product Quickview Demo](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Product-Quickview-Demo.gif)

When using *Product Quickview*, you can use *Woo Templates* to dynamically control the **Product Quickview** **layout/design**.

**Click here** to learn more about using *Woo Templates*with *Product Quickview*.

![Adding Wootemplate Blocks](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Adding-Wootemplate-Blocks.gif)

Woo Template Settings

Use the **Woo** **Template** **Settings** to control where the current Woo Template will override and who will see it. Click on the **pencil/paper icon** in the top right of the editor.

Each template type will have available Woo Template Settings to control where and to whom the template will appear. This also includes the option to set an expiration on the Woo Template. 

Use the resources below to learn more about each template type and its available settings.

- [Single Product](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/build-single-product-template/) templates
- [Product Archive](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/product-archive-woo-templates/) templates
- [Product Catalog Loop Item](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/product-catalog-loop-item-woo-templates/) templates
- [Quickview](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/product-quickview/#creating-a-custom-quickview-wootemplate) templates

![Template Settings](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Template-Settings.jpg)

pages.content:
Kadence Shop Kit allows you to create custom templates for WooCommerce single product pages and archives. A Woo Template is a custom post type and is not associated with a product. However, when you design a Woo Template, it is useful to see how a particular product looks in your template. Therefore, Shop Kit allows you to select a product to preview.

1. While editing a Woo Template, click on the **Template Settings** button to the right of the **Publish** button.
2. Click **Preview Settings**.
3. Click **Select Preview Product**.
4. Select a product to display.

![Woo Template Preview Settings](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Woo-Template-Preview-Settings-1024x512-1.jpeg)Woo Template Preview Settings

![Select Preview Product Button](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Select-Preview-Product-Button-1024x512-1.jpeg)Select Preview Product Button

![Select Preview Product Selection](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Select-Preview-Product-Selection-1024x480-1.jpeg)Select Preview Product Selection

Kadence Shop Kit allows you to set a few **Variation Options**. Products in your store can have variable products with different prices, and this feature allows you to set the price(s) that appear for your variable products. There are three options available.

pages.title: Single Product Templates (Woo Templates)
pages.category: Shop Kit 2 0 Building A Product Template
pages.content:
The [Kadence Shop Kit](https://www.kadencewp.com/kadence-shopkit/pricing/) plugin features the **Single Product Woo Template**, allowing you to dynamically control and customize **WooCommerce Product Pages**. Choose from a variety of customizable [Woo Template Blocks](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/) to display and style multiple elements of the single product page. This includes the product title, gallery, price, add to cart button, and more.

This document will go over the process of building and using a Single Product Woo Template. **Click here** to learn about the four *Woo Template types*.

![Single Product Demo](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Single-Product-Demo.gif)

Creating a Single Product Woo Template

In order to create a **Single Product Woo Template**, you must install, activate, and license the **Kadence** **Shop** **Kit** plugin. ([Click here to learn more](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/install-activate-kadence-shop-kit/).) Once the *Shop Kit* plugin is activated on the website, navigate to the **Dashboard -> Shop Kit** page and go to the **Product** **Templates** tab.

![Enable Product Templates](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Enable-Product-Templates.jpg)

*Enable Product Templates* and save the changes. Afterward, refresh the page. Then, navigate to the **Dashboard -> Products -> Woo Templates** page. At the top of the *Woo Templates page*, click on the **Add New Woo Templates** button.

![Add New Woo Template](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Add-New-Woo-Template-1024x850-1.jpg)

This will open a **new** **Woo** **Template** **Post** with the option to select the template type. Select the **Single Product** option to get started.

![Single Product Woo Template](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Single-Product-Woo-Template.jpg)

Once you have selected the template type, you will have the option to select a **prebuilt template**. The prebuilt templates include *preconfigured Woo Template blocks* and can help simplify the task of designing the entire product page. There are three main prebuilt templates available. You can also start from a **blank** state if preferred.

![Prebuilt Single Product Templates](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Prebuilt-Single-Product-Templates-scaled-1.jpg)

![Single Product Demo 1](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Single-Product-Demo-1-scaled-1.jpg)

There are various **Woo Template Blocks** that can be used within the Single Product Page. Some common *Woo Template Blocks* that can help you get started include the following:

- [Product Gallery Block](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/product-gallery-block/)
- [Product: Title Block](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/product-title-block/)
- [Product: Price Block](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/product-price-block/)
- [Product: Description Block](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/product-description-block/)
- [Product: Meta Block](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/product-meta-block/)
- [Product: Rating Block](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/product-rating-block/)
- [Product: Add to Cart Block](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/product-add-to-cart-block/)
- [Product: Upsell Block](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/product-upsell-block/)

There are many more Woo Template Blocks that can also be used in Single Product Templates. For a complete list and overview of each available Woo Template Block, [click here.](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/)

Start by designing the layout and styling of your Single Product Page using core and [Kadence Blocks](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/). Then, use*Woo Template Blocks* to display product information dynamically. Next, use the Block Settings for each block to adjust the look and behavior to your liking.

![Single Product Woo Template](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Single-Product-Woo-Template.gif)

Once the Single Product Page is designed and working the way you would like, use the Woo Template Settings to control which products the template will apply to.

Woo Template Settings

Use the **Woo** **Template** **Settings** to control where the current Woo Template will override and who will see it. Click on the **pencil/paper icon** in the top right of the editor.

![Woo Template Settings Single Product](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Woo-Template-Settings-Single-Product.jpg)

**Template Type:** Define the template type. This document overviews the *Single Product Woo Template*. However, there are other Woo Template types available as well.

**Display Settings -> Show On:**Use the Display Settings to determine where the Single Product Woo Template will take effect. Use the Add Rule button to include additional options.

- **Select Product By:** This setting allows you to further specify which Single Products the template will apply to. Options include: By Group *(Taxonomy)*, By Author, or by an Individual selection. Each option will allow you to further specify the products shown. *(See the GIF below)*

![Display settings extended](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Display-settings-extended.gif)

**User Settings -> Visible To:** Determine which user roles will be able to see the Woo Template in effect.

- Options include: All Users (Default), Logged Out Users, Logged In Users, or based on the website Role. Use the *Add Rule button* to add more visibility options.

**Expires Settings:** Enable this option to add an expiration to the Woo Template. Once the expiration is met, the Woo Template will no longer take effect.

![Expires](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Expires.jpg)

![Single Product Templates](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Single-Product-Templates.jpg)

pages.title: Size Charts
pages.content:
With the Kadence Shop Kit plugin, you can add size charts to any product or select a whole category of products to add to. You can enable this via a button that opens a modal or as a WooCommerce tab.

### Getting Installed

First, install the Kadence Shop Kit plugin and go into the “Shop Kit” menu in the bottom left corner of your screen.

You can click on “Size chart” and enable them for your site. Once enabled, reload the page, and you will see a new menu in your admin menu for “size charts.”

![](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Screenshot-2023-02-03-at-2.24.35-PM.png)

![](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Screenshot-2023-02-03-at-2.24.41-PM-1024x959-1.png)

---

### Creating a Size Chart

Next, you can click on the “Size Chart” and then “add new”.

![](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Screenshot-2023-02-03-at-2.30.38-PM-scaled.png)

The title will be your size chart title, so you can add something like “t-shirt size chart.” You can add an image or a size chart table in your size chart content. Or both. For a table, use the table block.

---

### Size Chart Placement

Below the content area, you have settings for enabling the size chart. Your first setting is placement, and you can set how you want the size chart to appear on the product page. The first five options would let you choose to place a button that would appear on the product page. That button would lead to a modal holding your size chart content.

![Size Chart Modal Button](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/kt_size_charts_05.jpg)

![Size Chart Modal](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/kt_size_charts_06.jpg)

The last option in placement is to place it as a tab on your product page.

![Size Chart in Tab](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/kt_size_charts_07-1024x669-1.jpg)

---

### Size Chart Options

![Size Chart Settings](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/kt_size_charts_04.jpg)

Below your placement options, you can set the colors for the modal and modal buttons (if using). You can also set the tab priority (if using). Other valuable options allow you to change the colors in the size chart modal. You can also change settings for the modal button, including the button text. You can also assign your size charts to categories, so they only show where you want them to display.

---

### Assigning to a Product

Near the bottom, you have an option to assign this size chart to show a whole category of products on your site. But if you want to assign to one or a few, you can leave that blank, and each product individually assigns a size chart.

Assign Chart to Categories:

![Sizing Chart Categories](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/kt_size_charts_08-1.jpg)

Set chart in product settings:

![Assign Size Chart in Product](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/kt_size_charts_09-1.jpg)

pages.title: Variation Swatches
pages.content:
**Kadence** **Shop** **Kit** provides powerful tools to help increase your **WooCommerce** **store’s** **sales**. One of its key features is the ability to customize how **product** **variations** are **displayed**. With flexible options such as dropdowns and radio buttons, you can create a more engaging and intuitive experience that helps customers connect more easily with your products.

---

## Getting Started

To get started, you should do the following:

- Install and activate the [Kadence Shop Kit](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/install-activate-kadence-shop-kit/) plugin.
- Navigate to Shop Kit in the bottom-left corner of your WordPress dashboard.
- Open the Variation Swatches tab.
- Enable variation swatches for your site.

![Enable Swatches](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Enable-Swatches.jpg)

---

Product Page Settings

![Product Page Settings](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Product-Page-Settings.jpg)

**Variation label display:** Set the display settings for your Label. This can be set to:

- Beside the variation (default)
- Above the variation
- Hidden

**Choose a default swatch type:** Choose the default swatch type for your variations.

- Dropdown select box
- Radio buttons
- Color swatches
- Image swatches
- Taxonomy-defined

Notes:

- When using taxonomy-defined, you can assign a swatch type for each attribute under WooCommerce → Attributes.
- Swatch types can also be overridden on a per-product basis. See below for more information on this feature.

*This can also be set on a product-to-product basis. See below for more information on this feature.*
**Choose a default swatch label open:** This setting controls how the swatch label is shown. It can be set to No label, Show above, Show below, or Show above on hover. This option can also be overridden on a per-product basis.

**Choose a default swatch size:**This setting controls the size of each swatch option. This can be set globally here or individually on a product-to-product basis.

**Dropdown “Choose an option” text:** This setting allows you to set the default placeholder text for dropdown swatch selections.

## Configure Product Variations

Before variations can be displayed on a single product page, you must first create them under **Product Data → Attributes**. Define your attributes (such as size or color) and enable them for use in variations.

For example, see the variation below:

![](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Screen-Shot-2022-09-13-at-4.58.59-PM-min-1024x322-1.png)

Once your variations are created, be sure to:

- Set a price for each variation.
- Assign an image to each variation.
- Optionally add multiple images to create a variation image gallery.

![](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Screen-Shot-2022-09-15-at-11.17.45-AM-min-1024x615-1.png)

**Important:** The Shop Kit Variation Gallery **only replaces the main WooCommerce product gallery**.

- If the main product gallery has no images, variation images will not display on the frontend.
- Always add at least one image to the main product gallery to ensure variation images load correctly.

The **Variation Gallery** feature requires the [Shop Kit Product Gallery](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/product-galleries/) to be enabled. Variation Galleries will not function unless the Product Gallery feature is active.

---

## Swatch Attributes

Once your variations are configured, save the product and the swatches will use your global default settings. If needed, you can customize how swatches display for individual products.

To do this, open the **Variation Swatches** tab under **Product Data**. From there, you can:

- Select the variation style.
- Adjust the label display.
- Set the swatch size.
- Assign a color or image to each swatch.

![](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Screen-Shot-2022-09-14-at-2.43.19-PM-min-1024x644-1.png)

After configuring your swatches, preview the product to confirm that your settings are applied correctly.

![](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Screen-Shot-2022-09-15-at-11.14.23-AM-min-1024x812-1.png)

---

## Variation Styles

Displayed below are the styling options available for your product variations.

Dropdown:

![](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Screen-Shot-2022-09-14-at-3.23.27-PM-min-1024x565-1.png)

Variation Radio Boxes:

![](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Screen-Shot-2022-09-14-at-3.25.59-PM-min-1024x447-1.png)

Variation Color or Image Swatches:

![](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Screen-Shot-2022-09-14-at-3.20.46-PM-min-1024x702-1.png)

---

Archive Settings

To display variation swatches on archive pages (Shop, Product Categories, and Tags), enable the **Enable Swatches for Archives** option.

**Archive Swatch Mode** options:

- **Normal** – Displays all attributes
- **Catalog Mode** – Displays only one attribute

**Swatch Position**:  This option determines where the swatches display on archives. Available options are:

- Before Title
- After Title
- Before Price
- After Price

**Variation label display:** This option controls how each label is displayed. Available options are:

- Beside Variation
- Above the variation
- Hidden (default)

**Choose a default swatch size** **option**: This option sets the swatches’ default size.

![Kadence Shop Kit ‹ Lala — WordPress 2025-07-22 at 8.03.25 AM](https://p-d0FK22zG.t2.n0.cdn.zight.com/items/nOuOw9BE/2571e7a8-4d61-44fc-84f9-cebb49c500ea.jpg)

This is a screenshot of the variation product with one attribute.

![](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Shop-Lala-2025-07-22-at-8.20.19-AM-1024x625-1.jpg)

- *Showing as color swatches.*
- *Label set to show above the variation*

If variation swatches are enabled on archives, they’ll also show in the Quickview. Here’s how it looks:

![](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Shop-Lala-2025-07-22-at-8.22.12-AM-1024x578-1.jpg)

## Variation Galleries:

Variation Galleries allow you to assign multiple images to individual product variations. When a customer selects a variation on the product page, the product gallery automatically updates to display only the images associated with that variation.

### Dependency Requirement

The **Variation Gallery** feature depends on the **Shop Kit Product Gallery** feature being enabled. Variation Galleries will not work unless the **Product Gallery** feature is active. Using **Variation Galleries** without enabling the **Product Gallery** can result in missing gallery options.

pages.title: Woo Template Block – Archive: Main Query

pages.content:

![Archive Main Query](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/archivemainquery-scaled.png)

![Product Archive Template](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Product-Archive-Template.png)

pages.title: Woo Template Block – Product: Add to Cart
pages.category: Woo Template Block Product Add To Cart
pages.content:
Every pre-designed **Woo Template** comes with a **Product: Add to Cart** block. You can manually add one by adding a new block and searching for the Product: Add to Cart block. When you view all of your blocks the Product: Add to Cart block will be under a block group named Woo Template Blocks. If you need to know how to enable these blocks, refer to [How to Enable Woo Template Blocks](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/enable-woo-template-blocks/).

![New Product Add To Cart Block](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/new_productcart_block.png)

![Woo Template Blocks](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/all_wootemplate_blocks-e1667311493454.png)

In the **Block Settings** of a **Product: Add to Cart** block, the first setting is labeled **General Settings**, where you will see the following;

**Show Quantity –** This option will show the quantity of the product being purchased. This will enable users to add multiple instances of the same product to their cart at once. You can raise or lower the quantity number by using the up and down arrows in the quantity box. If you enable the *Show Quantity* option, you will see an additional *Block Setting* named *Quantity Input* where you can adjust additional settings for your quantity box. This option will only appear when using the *Single Product*****template. It will not be visible on *Product Loop Item* templates or *Product Archive* templates.

**Alignment –** The *Alignment* options are available if you are not using the *Force Button FullWidth* option. The *Alignment*options allow you to align your button either on the left, center, or right side of its parent container.

**Force Button FullWidth** **–**This option will allow you to make your add-to-cart button a full-width button. Enabling this option will remove the options to *Show Quantity*and remove the*Alignment* options.

![Add To Cart General Settings](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/addtocart_general_settings.gif)

**Button Settings**

The **Product: Add to Cart** block has the standard Kadence button settings. You can change the button’s text color, background color, and border color. You can set a regular color and a color for whenever the button is being hovered over. You can also adjust the border’s width and radius settings.

The **Typography Settings** will modify the text on your add-to-cart button. These settings include options to adjust the; font-size, line height, letter spacing, text transformation, font family, and font weight. You can also add additional padding to the text inside of your button.

![Add To Cart Button Settings](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/addtocart_buttonsettings.png)

![Add To Cart Typography Settings](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/addtocart_buttonsettings2.jpg)

**Quantity Input**

If you enable the **Show Quantity** option, you will have a **Block Setting** named **Quantity Input**. The *Quantity Input*settings give you the same options you had for your button, except these settings will be applied to the **Quantity Input Box** on the side of your button. You can adjust the *color*, *border*, *typography*, and *spacing* settings for the *Quantity Input Box*.

![Product Quantity Input Settings](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/quantity_input_settings.gif)

**Spacing Settings**

You have the ability to adjust the **Spacing Settings** for your **Product: Add to Cart**block. These settings will allow you to adjust the margin and the padding of your block. You can adjust the padding or margin for *desktop*, *tablet*, and *mobile* devices.

![Spacing Settings](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/spacing_settings.jpg)

![Advanced Settings](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/advanced_settings.png)

**Advanced**

The final setting is the **Advanced** setting. You can create **HTML Anchors** or add **Custom CSS** classes to your block. An **HTML Anchor** allows you to create a unique web address that links to the block’s position on the page. **Additional CSS Class(es)** enables you to add one or multiple CSS classes that will be applied to this block.

pages.title: Woo Template Block Product: Additional Information
pages.category: Woo Template Block Product Additional Information
pages.content:
The Product: Additional Information block allows you to display the attributes of a product.

![Product: Additional Information](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Product-Additional-Showcase-e1670945105589-scaled.png)

Adding Additional Information

The Product: Additional Information block displays the current attributes of a product. You can add attributes to your product. First, you will need to edit the product. Then look for the product data box. In the product data box, there will be a tab labeled attributes. Here you can add attributes that will display on your Product: Additional Information block.

pages.title: Woo Template Block – Product: Notice
pages.content:
Whenever you add a WooCommerce product to your cart, there is a notice that tells the user the product was added to the cart. This ensures the customer that their product has been successfully added to the cart. The Product: Notice block is a Woo Template block that allows you to customize this notice. If you need to know how to enable these blocks, refer to [How to Enable Woo Template Blocks](https://docs.nexcess.com/software/kadence/enable-woo-template-blocks/).

![Product Notice Presentation](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Product-Notice-Presentation-1536x797-1.png)

Adding a Product Notice

You can add the Product: Notice block to your Woo Template like any other Block. You can manually add one by adding a new block and searching for the Product: Notice block. When you view all of your blocks, the Product: Notice block will be under a block group named Woo Template Blocks.

![Add New Product Notice](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Add-New-Product-Notice.gif)

Product: Notice Block Settings

The Product: Notice allows you to customize the design of the add-to-cart notice. You can do this by configuring the Product: Notice Block Settings.

![Access Block Settings](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Access-Block-Settings.png)

Product Notice Styling Block Settings

In the Product Notice Styling Block Settings, you can customize various things. 

You can customize the color settings. This changes the color of the “Example has been added to your cart” text.

You can also customize the background of the Notice. This changes the background behind the text and button.

The border options allow you to add a border to all sides of your Notice. You can also adjust the colors for the borders. 

You can adjust the border width and border radius for mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.

![Product Notice Styling Settings](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Product-Notice-Styling-Settings.png)

You can customize the Typography settings for your Product: Notice.

This allows you to adjust the font size, line height, and letter spacing for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

The text transform option allows you to set a text transformation on the text of your Product: Notice block.

The final Styling setting is the font weight setting. This option allows to to select a different font weight for the Product: Notice block.

![Product Notice Styling Settings 2](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Product-Notice-Styling-Settings-2.png)

Product Notice Button Styling Block Settings

You can customize the button on your Product: Notice by configuring the Button Styling Block Setting.

You can customize the color settings. This changes the color of the text inside of the button that says “View Cart”. You can set an initial color for the button text and a hover color.

The background setting allows you to change the color of the background on the “View Cart” button. You can set an initial background and a background for whenever the button is hovered.

The border options allow you to add a border to all sides of your button. You can also adjust the colors for the borders. You can set the initial color and hover colors for the borders.

You can adjust the border width and border radius for mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.

![Product Notice Button Styling Settings](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Product-Notice-Button-Styling-Settings.png)

You can customize the Typography settings for your Notice Button.

This allows you to adjust the font size, line height, and letter spacing for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices. These settings only apply to the button.

The text transform option allows you to set a text transformation on your button.

The final Styling setting is the font weight setting. This option allows to to select a different font weight for the Product: Notice button.

![Product Notice Button Styling 2](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Product-Notice-Button-Styling-3.png)

Product Notice Spacing Settings

The spacing settings allow you to add a padding and margin to your Product: Notice block.

You can add a different padding and margin for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

![Product Notice Spacing Settings](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Product-Notice-Spacing-Settings.png)

Product Notice Advanced Settings

The advanced settings allow you to add additional CSS Class(es) to your Product: Notice block.

pages.title: Woo Template Block – Product: Upsell
pages.content:
WooCommerce gives you a lot of flexibility when creating your products. You can add short and long product descriptions, add variations, manage stock and shipping dimensions, and even make a list of upsell products. Upsell products are products you recommend your customer purchase instead of the currently viewed product. WooCommerce lets you add the list to any product you create as a linked product. Kadence’s Shop Kit provides the Product: Upsell block to add a gallery of your upsells to your Woo Templates.

Adding Upsells

You must add upsell products to your WooCommerce product before they become visible in the Product: Upsell block. WooCommerce provides documentation for [adding upsell and related products](https://woocommerce.com/document/related-products-up-sells-and-cross-sells/). Ensure that you have listed upsells on your products to maximize your potential sales.

![WooCommerce Linked Products Upsells](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/WooCommerce-Linked-Products-Upsells-1024x389-1.jpeg)WooCommerce Linked Products Upsells

Product: Upsell

The Product: Upsell block is easy to find in the block inserter. It has sections for General Settings, Product Styling, and Spacing Settings.

![Product Upsell block](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Product-Upsell-block.jpeg)Product Upsell block

![Product Upsell settings](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Product-Upsell-settings.jpeg)Product Upsell settings

General Settings

The General Settings gives you a few options. Here, you can remove the default heading above the products. The default heading usually reads, “You may also like…” If you want to remove the default heading, enable the option.

Also, you can adjust the number of columns for the products. You can adjust the number of columns for different screen sizes as well.

You can also set the upsell items limit. If you add many upsell items to your products you can set a limit with this setting.

![Product Upsell General Settings](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Product-Upsell-General-Settings.jpeg)Product Upsell General Settings

Product Styling

You can edit the styles of the Product: Upsell block in the Product Styling section. You can adjust the title and product background colors using a color selector. Also, you can change the font size, line height, and letter spacing for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices. There are also settings for text transformation, font family, and font weight.

![Product Styling settings for Product Upsell](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Product-Styling-settings-for-Product-Upsell.jpeg)Product Styling settings for Product Upsell

Spacing Settings

Another section for the block is the spacing settings. This section lets you change the padding and margin. You can set the space for each side individually or connect the top, right, bottom, and left for either the padding or the margin. You can adjust the spacing for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

![Spacing settings](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Spacing-settings.jpeg)Spacing settings

pages.title: Woo Template Block – Product: Upsell
pages.content:
WooCommerce gives you a lot of flexibility when creating your products. You can add short and long product descriptions, add variations, manage stock and shipping dimensions, and even make a list of upsell products. Upsell products are products you recommend your customer purchase instead of the currently viewed product. WooCommerce lets you add the list to any product you create as a linked product. Kadence’s Shop Kit provides the Product: Upsell block to add a gallery of your upsells to your Woo Templates.

Adding Upsells

You must add upsell products to your WooCommerce product before they become visible in the Product: Upsell block. WooCommerce provides documentation for [adding upsell and related products](https://woocommerce.com/document/related-products-up-sells-and-cross-sells/). Ensure that you have listed upsells on your products to maximize your potential sales.

![WooCommerce Linked Products Upsells](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/WooCommerce-Linked-Products-Upsells-1024x389-1.jpeg)WooCommerce Linked Products Upsells

Product: Upsell

The Product: Upsell block is easy to find in the block inserter. It has sections for General Settings, Product Styling, and Spacing Settings.

![Product Upsell block](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Product-Upsell-block.jpeg)Product Upsell block

![Product Upsell settings](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Product-Upsell-settings.jpeg)Product Upsell settings

General Settings

The General Settings gives you a few options. Here, you can remove the default heading above the products. The default heading usually reads, “You may also like…” If you want to remove the default heading, enable the option.

Also, you can adjust the number of columns for the products. You can adjust the number of columns for different screen sizes as well.

You can also set the upsell items limit. If you add many upsell items to your products you can set a limit with this setting.

![Product Upsell General Settings](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Product-Upsell-General-Settings.jpeg)Product Upsell General Settings

Product Styling

You can edit the styles of the Product: Upsell block in the Product Styling section. You can adjust the title and product background colors using a color selector. Also, you can change the font size, line height, and letter spacing for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices. There are also settings for text transformation, font family, and font weight.

![Product Styling settings for Product Upsell](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Product-Styling-settings-for-Product-Upsell.jpeg)Product Styling settings for Product Upsell

Spacing Settings

Another section for the block is the spacing settings. This section lets you change the padding and margin. You can set the space for each side individually or connect the top, right, bottom, and left for either the padding or the margin. You can adjust the spacing for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

![Spacing settings](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Spacing-settings.jpeg)Spacing settings

pages.title: Open Affiliate/External Products In A New Tab
pages.category: Wooextras Open Affiliate External Products In A New Tab
pages.content:
By default, there are no options in WooCommerce to open affiliate or external product links in another tab. This is one of the most frequently asked for features with those using WooCommerce for affiliate stores.

We built some amazing features into our [Kadence Shop Kit](https://www.kadencethemes.com/product/kadence-woo-extras/) plugin that allows for the “Add to cart” or action button to open in a new tab. We also added support to make the product image in an archive open to the affiliate link. Getting it set up is simple!

First, be sure you have the latest version of Kadence WooExtras installed on your site. Once installed, navigate to **Shop Kit > Affiliate Product Options** and enable the output:

![Enable affiliate options](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Affiliate-product-options.gif)

Once you’ve enabled the affiliate options in the Shop Kit Settings, turn on the features you’d like to use.

Product Archive Settings appear as follows:

![Affiliate product archive settings](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Affiliate-product-archive-settings.jpg)

Single Product Options:

![Affiliate product single settings](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Affiliate-product-single-settings.jpg)

Once you’re happy with your affiliate product settings, configure your affiliate/external products.

To configure an external/affiliate product, set the product data and add the product URL.  You can also change the “Buy Product” button text to whatever you like:

![External/Affiliate Product](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/02ConfigureExternalProduct-min-1.jpeg)

Set the up the information for the product as you would for any other product. Publish the product, and test that your link opens as desired.

pages.title: Woo Template Block – Product: Image
pages.content:
When creating Woo Templates, you can access the Product: Image block. This block displays the featured image of the current product.

Find the Product: Image block under the Woo Template Blocks section and add it to your template like any other block.

Product: Image Block Settings

![Product Image General Settings](https://docs.nexcess.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/product_image_general.jpg)
